text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri: No privatisation of the Suez Canal company or big economic projects. The first phase of the New Valley canal to cost $250 million.
- A two-day economic conference starts today to pave the way for the upcoming November economic summit.
- Foreign Minister Amr Moussa visits Oslo on Wednesday to discuss the stalled Middle East peace process.
- An increase in total banks deposits by 18 billion pounds in one year.
- Egypt exerts pressure on Britain to make it ban a terrorist conference.
- The government to offer the shares of eight public companies worth 758 million pounds.
- New treasury bills worth 4 billion pounds to be issued next Sunday.
